greeting: An open Thursday in St. Pete with the girls around, and just a noon call to anchor it. The kind of quiet day that's good for the bookings that have been sliding.

needsAttention.title: Croatia lodging still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: Two p1 tasks are past due: the Cavtat night of Sept 19 and the St. Pete landing gap Sept 20-22. The charter departs Sept 8 with poor connectivity aboard, so both need booking from dry land beforehand.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Croatia checked bags
needsAttention.detail: A p1 task flags the issued ticket as 0 checked bags on the Eurowings Discover legs. Confirm the allowance on the operating carrier's site and buy bags online now, before the higher airport-counter fees.

needsAttention.title: Kids' passport packet due before Aug 28
needsAttention.detail: Mike's p1 task to assemble the four girls' passport packet closes before tomorrow: unsigned DS-11s, birth-certificate copies, and two separate payments (a State Dept check, USPS by card). Worth a check it's on track.

flagged.title: Google Cloud gov-affairs role
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert surfaced a Regional Lead, Market Development & Government Affairs opening at Google Cloud, squarely in your public-affairs lane.

inbox.noise: The rest of the unread inbox is retail sales, travel promos, and newsletters.

recipe.title: Chambéry Trout
recipe.why: High summer wants something light and quick — fresh trout with vermouth suits the season's heat.

acts.line: A clear run until noon, the longest uninterrupted stretch of the day.
One call at noon with Martin at Valoris, then the afternoon reopens.
Nothing on the calendar, and the girls are with you in St. Pete.
